Start with the light you want

Roller shades use a single fabric panel that rolls onto a tube above the window. A subtle texture can work alongside curtains, while a patterned fabric can stand on its own. Beautiful Blinds & Shades helps you compare fabrics, mounting options, and controls for your Fort Wayne windows.

Light-filtering fabrics

These soften daylight while keeping the fabric visible across the window. Privacy varies with the fabric and the lighting on either side. For a street-facing room, tell us how you use the space after dark as well as during the day.

Room-darkening and blackout fabrics

For bedrooms or media rooms, compare fabrics designed to block more light. The fabric is only part of the result: light may still enter beside the shade, above the roll, or around the bottom. We discuss coverage and mounting together.

Texture, roll, and finish

Compare colors, woven textures, and patterns at the window. Ask about exposed rolls, cassette or valance options, and the way the fabric rolls away from the glass. These details affect both appearance and clearance.

Measured and installed for you

Roller shades installation in Fort Wayne

We measure mounting depth and check the window handles, trim, and space for the roll. Inside mounting sits within the opening; outside mounting extends over it. For wide windows or a row of adjacent shades, we discuss where individual shades and their controls will sit.

Before you choose

For hard-to-reach windows, ask about motorization. We’ll check power or charging access and help you choose compatible controls. Tell us which smart-home system you use so we can check whether it will work with the shades.

From samples to installation

David brings samples to your home and measures the opening. Once you have chosen the material and controls, we confirm the quote and expected timing. We return to install the treatment, check its operation, and show you how to use it.

Compare all shades

Caring for your roller shades

Follow the cleaning instructions for your selected fabric and backing. Dust lightly and check before applying water or cleaning products. Do not scrub a coating or force a shade that is rolling unevenly; contact us about operation or repair.

Questions about roller shades

Talk through your windows, the room, and the options before ordering.

Call David at (260) 222-6467
Will blackout roller shades make the room completely dark?

Blackout fabric blocks light through the fabric, but the finished shade can still have light gaps. We assess the opening and discuss mounting or additional coverage where darkness is a priority.

What is the difference between roller and solar shades?

Both roll up, but solar shades use an open screen fabric intended for glare control with some outward view. Roller fabrics offer different levels of light control and privacy. Solar screen fabric should not be relied on for nighttime privacy.

How much do custom roller shades cost?

Window size, fabric, finishing hardware, and controls determine the quote. We measure your windows and compare choices during the free consultation before you place an order.
